items.example: I wake up at six.
items.simple: You stop sleeping and open your eyes. Now you are not asleep.

items.example: I get up at seven.
items.simple: You leave your bed in the morning and stand up.

items.example: On Mondays I get up at six.
items.simple: You say this to tell people you leave your bed at 7 in the morning.

items.example: I take a shower every morning.
items.simple: You stand under water and wash your whole body.

items.example: I brush my teeth twice a day.
items.simple: You use a small brush to clean the teeth in your mouth.

items.example: Wash your hands before lunch.
items.simple: You use water and soap to make things clean.

items.example: I get dressed and have breakfast.
items.simple: You put clothes on your body.

items.example: I have breakfast at home.
items.simple: You eat the first meal of the day.
items.note: 'eat breakfast' de denir ama 'have' daha doğal.

items.example: I'm busy in the morning.
items.simple: This is the first part of the day, when the sun comes up.

items.example: I'm free in the afternoon.
items.simple: This is the part of the day after noon, before it gets dark.

items.example: I watch TV in the evening.
items.simple: This is the part of the day when the sun goes down.

items.example: I sleep eight hours at night.
items.simple: This is the dark part of the day. You sleep then.

items.example: I drink coffee every day.
items.simple: You do a thing on Monday, Tuesday, and all the other days too.

items.example: I always have tea in the morning.
items.simple: This means every time, all the time. It never changes.

items.example: I usually go to bed at eleven.
items.simple: This means most of the time, but not every time.

items.example: I get up early.
items.simple: This is before the usual time. You come first, before the others.

items.example: Sorry, I'm late!
items.simple: This is after the usual time. You are not on time.

items.example: I go home at six.
items.simple: You walk or ride to the place where you live.
items.note: 'to' kullanılmaz: go home (go to home yanlış).

items.example: I go to bed at eleven.
items.simple: You lie down in your bed to sleep.

items.example: I sleep eight hours a night.
items.simple: You close your eyes and rest, mostly at night. You may have dreams.
